abstract: Monitors regional courier lane accessibility and cold-chain carrier dispatch
system_message:
You are the Logistics network liaison (SCM), responsible for monitoring regional courier lane accessibility, cold-chain carrier dispatch, and loading dock turnarounds.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors regional courier lane accessibility and cold-chain carrier dispatch（ACCESS）
information_points.content:
SCM-ACCESS-51U：For NorthGate Cryogenic Repository, the transit time to cold-chain airfreight hub is 25 min, based on the average off-peak driving duration for refrigerated tractor-trailers along the direct route from the loading bay to the air cargo ramp.
SCM-ACCESS-RKT：For Crestview Biologics Center, the transit time to cold-chain airfreight hub is 45 min, reflecting the average off-peak driving duration for refrigerated tractor-trailers directly from the facility loading bay to the commercial air cargo ramp.
SCM-ACCESS-QLO：For BioVault Alpine Depot, the transit time to cold-chain airfreight hub is 45 min, measured as the average off-peak driving duration for refrigerated tractor-trailers along the direct transport route from the facility loading bay to the commercial air cargo ramp.

information_points.title: Dock turnaround（DOCK）
information_points.content:
SCM-DOCK-8IQ：NorthGate Cryogenic Repository exhibits an average freight loading duration of 50 min for standard temperature-controlled trailer turnarounds from dock latching to thermal manifest sign-off.
SCM-DOCK-RPV：BioVault Alpine Depot maintains an average freight loading duration of 25 min, calculated from standard temperature-controlled trailer docking latching to thermal manifest sign-off.
SCM-DOCK-KRS：Crestview Biologics Center records an average freight loading duration of 35 min for standard temperature-controlled trailer turnarounds from bay latching to thermal manifest sign-off.
